title: Move storage_guard into susi-config so xtask stops linking susi-harness
goal: Vision: V-10. Mandate 84 (harness cut, step 2 prerequisite for core T-CORESIZEVAULT-15). xtask re-exports susi_harness::storage_guard for local-snapshot and the local-workflow witness, so susi-harness cannot be deleted while xtask links it. Move storage_guard.rs and the workflow-wire code it needs (workflow request, result decoding, wire paths, the error envelope) into susi-config, net zero: susi-harness's git_governor and operator.rs call the susi-config copy, xtask re-exports it from susi-config and drops its susi-harness dependency. Runtime code stays counted (Mandate 84 rule 6).

reuse.searched: core's storage_guard.rs and git_governor's workflow wire (moved, not rewritten); susi-config's mcp_session::try_call_reply_with_info, which the harness tool backend already calls; channel_bindings' earlier move into the core library (79074568c) as the pattern.

limitations: Net zero by design: one workflow_call_or_with in susi-config takes the call function, so the harness keeps its own MCP client and test fixture. storage_audit always carries a working directory, so only stdio providers are reached and the harness's HTTP transport registration does not matter.
